Population increased in Stockport

The estimated population of Stockport in 2024 was 303,929 usual residents, a rise of 1.2% since 2023.

This meant that Stockport's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Stockport increased by 2.9%.

Over this slightly longer period, Stockport was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Stockport

The average (median) age fell to 41.9 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Stockport has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Stockport is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Stockport's population of 303,929 usual residents was made up of:

  • 57,604 people aged 0 to 15 years, (19%)
  • 185,090 people aged 16 to 64 years, (60.9%)
  • 61,235 people aged 65 years and over, (20.1%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Stockport has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 16 to 64 years (60.9% compared with 62.8% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Stockport, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Stockport
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Stockport, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 49 people (0%). In total, there were 2,887 births and 2,936 deaths in Stockport.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,103 (0.4%). There were 15,899 people entering the area and 14,796 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Stockport's population of 2,532 (0.8%) as a result of 3,370 people entering the area and 838 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Stockport was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Stockport in mid-2023 is 300,326.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 920 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 139 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 781 people.
